highlights: Up to four lights of your own, balanced to one light's exposure, and a Shadow strength slider
Any control on any shelf: hold Alt and drag a checkbox, slider or readout where you want it
Navigation bindings: hold a key and drag to orbit, pan or zoom, set up in one place
Primitive settings for appended Parts, and Solidify gives a flat Part thickness
Keep Face Groups through Voxel Remesh, and N-drag refreshes stretched topology under the brush
